rationale: The JS lane gains the SVG stroke cap/join/miter style the native and baked C++ lanes already apply: a setSvgStrokeStyle WidgetBridge call on SvgPath (manifest row, generated typings, mocks and js-bridge docs regenerated) and one emitted call per styled vector in generated JS, from the shared parser. Additive bridge surface; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
